answer: Each identity posts a 70-credit bond in an ocean registry keyed by wallet, and pays a sybil tax per epoch: first from a wallet pays 35, the k-th 35+6(k-1). A quartz seal binds identity, epoch, amount to each payment; auditors recompute the ladder and burn cheats. A velvet receipt ties payer to identity key; a rented wallet splitting the ladder burns both bonds. Forging 1,000 identities costs 3,032,000 against 40,000 rewards. Honest agents pay 35.
